certification.name: Certified Security Operations Manager
certification.description: Security operations management certification covering SOC building, team and capability development, threat modelling, metrics and maturity assessment. Assessed by a hybrid exam with practical and theoretical parts; issued by Centri, the provider formerly named Security Blue Team.
certification.currency_note: Vendor lists GBP only (GBP 1,999); converted at 1.3423 USD/GBP (ECB reference rate, 2026-11-10); price covers training and exam
